QUOTE: `#ifndef MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS
#define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) private_##member
#else
#define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) member
#endif` and "by default the field is really named `private_foo`"

WHY: The answer shows the macro definition and states that by default the member becomes private_<member>. Its code block shows that defining MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS makes the macro expand to the bare member name, and the table says the opt-out gives "plain field names".
